# Trusted Properties

> Bengaluru property information and enquiry website covering ten SOBHA apartment and plotted communities.

This is not the official SOBHA website. All prices and completion dates are indicative information from the supplied project guide, not live quotations or verified inventory. Visuals are illustrative.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://trustedproperties.net/): Overview, imagery and enquiry form.
- [All Bengaluru properties](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/): Compare every listed project.
- [Property FAQs](https://trustedproperties.net/faqs/): Pricing, configurations, plots, timelines and enquiry information.
- [Property films](https://trustedproperties.net/films/): Eight supplied reference videos.

## Project guides

- [SOBHA One World](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-one-world/): Greater Whitefield · Old Madras Road; 1, 2, 3 & 4 BHK; ₹1.10 Cr (Starting basic price).
- [SOBHA Altair](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-altair/): Off Sarjapura Road · Beside Royal Pavilion; 3 & 4 BHK; ₹3.55 Cr (Starting basic price).
- [SOBHA Neopolis](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-neopolis/): Silver Oaks Main Road · Off Panathur Road; 1, 3 & 4 BHK; ₹94 L (Starting basic price · 1 BHK).
- [SOBHA Ayana](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-ayana/): Panathur Road · East Bengaluru; 3 BHK; ₹2.30 Cr (Starting basic price).
- [SOBHA Infinia](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-infinia/): HSR Layout · Bengaluru; 3 & 4 BHK; ₹4.22 Cr (Starting guide price).
- [SOBHA Sacred Grove](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-sacred-grove/): Chikka Tirupati · Bengaluru; Residential plots; ₹8,200 / sq ft (Approx. inclusive rate in guide).
- [SOBHA Chartered Birdsong](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-chartered-birdsong/): Off Rajanakunte · Bengaluru; Residential plots; ₹8,443 / sq ft (Approx. inclusive rate in guide).
- [SOBHA Insignia](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-insignia/): Off ORR · Behind Embassy Tech Village; 3.5 BHK; ₹3.73 Cr (Starting basic price).
- [SOBHA Townpark](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-townpark/): Hosur Main Road · Opposite Ramee Guestline; 2, 3 & 4 BHK; ₹1.65 Cr (Starting basic price · 2 BHK).
- [SOBHA Magnus](https://trustedproperties.net/properties/sobha-magnus/): Bannerghatta Road · Behind Meenakshi Temple; 2, 3 & 4 BHK; ₹3.29 Cr (Starting basic price · 3 BHK).

## Source and text versions

- [Source project guide](https://trustedproperties.net/project-guide.pdf): Supplied SOBHA reference; current details must be confirmed.
- [Full text collection](https://trustedproperties.net/llms-full.txt): Project facts and FAQ answers in one file.
- [Project data](https://trustedproperties.net/data/projects.json): Machine-readable facts and canonical links.
- [Home in Markdown](https://trustedproperties.net/index.md): Text version of the overview.
- [Privacy notice](https://trustedproperties.net/privacy/): Form data and contact consent.

Project pages also have Markdown versions at their canonical directory URL followed by index.md. These text versions describe the same facts available to visitors.
